video_title: Karl-Anthony Towns Goes One on One Against Spicy Wings | Hot Ones

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the impact of winning a championship
quotes.excerpt: winning a championship was obviously a lifelong mission
quotes.quote: I wouldn't say I've had a comedown yet. I feel like winning a championship was obviously a lifelong mission. To be able to go from that to really what life's all about, the things that really get you going and motivate you to even play more basketball, it was really cool.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns explains the mechanics of a Gortat screen
quotes.excerpt: when the big rolls and he gets in the way of the person able to guard the guard
quotes.quote: When you do a pick and roll and the big rolls and he gets in the way of the person able to guard the guard who's doing that, that's the Gortat screen. So when you stick your leg out or you're putting your arm out, that's not a legal action of setting a pick. Sometimes it's just easier to just kind of get in the way. And I think obviously that's the whole point of the Gortat screen, but it works great. Jalen Brunson lives off of them. Well, Mitchell Robinson.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the toughest players to tag the roller
quotes.excerpt: the person that's toughest is probably going to be like DeMarcus Cousins or Steven Adams
quotes.quote: I would say the person that's toughest is probably going to be like DeMarcus Cousins or Steven Adams. I've probably in my life ever had to tag the roller. During defense, you're on the other side and you come over to tag the roller to hold him up so he doesn't DeAndre Jordan, alley-oop dunk, Blake Griffin, alley-oop dunk like that, Mitchell Robinson, alley-oop dunk. You try to slow down the roller so it makes it easier to deal with the pick and roll, the player, two offensive players and the two defensive players. It makes it easier and gives them more time to figure out the situation with the PNR.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the best defensive coaches at icing
quotes.excerpt: any Tom Thibodeau team is going to be a great at icing
quotes.quote: Any Tom Thibodeau team is going to be a great at icing. I could guarantee it. That's when you get on the sideline, you say ice, you keep them on the sideline. So even if the screen is sending the ball handler back to the middle, you continue to send the ball handler to the sideline. The icer person, big with me, would be a step below kind of figuring out when the time, you know, I could get out to get back to the five or the four, or it is to maybe stay and guard the guard that's coming off the ice pick.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns chooses another NBA title over a World Series
quotes.excerpt: win a World Series for sure. I've already won an NBA championship
quotes.quote: Win a World Series for sure. I've already won an NBA championship. That would be cool kind of like add another trophy to the case. Why not? This is like the E-God of sports. I'm about to go next and win an MLS Cup too on that.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on the mythical status of Hakeem Olajuwon
quotes.excerpt: I think Hakeem. And I feel like in a way he kind of is like mythical like Wilt Chamberlain
quotes.quote: I think Hakeem. And I feel like in a way he kind of is like mythical like Wilt Chamberlain. Like, you know, but we have something to watch Hakeem games on, but like it's kind of like that same mythical creature like Wilt, but I've been able to talk and meet Hakeem and he's an amazing human. So I'm very honored to say that.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on playing against Kobe and LeBron as a teen
quotes.excerpt: I was just ready if my opportunity, my number was called and it was and I made the most of it
quotes.quote: I was just ready if my opportunity, my number was called and it was and I made the most of it. I felt very excited for the opportunity to go out there and show the world, even if it was 20 seconds, 30 seconds, just, you know, pregame warmups that I deserve to be on that court.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on Al Horford tweeting about him

quotes.quote: I remember when Al Horford tweeted at me about on being on the team and I went crazy to my mom. I was like, I can't believe Al Horford knows who I am. That's so crazy to think like NBA All-Star Al Horford knows who I am.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on what Rasheed Wallace taught him
quotes.excerpt: being able to space the floor, shoot the three, play with aggression, be unapologetically yourself
quotes.quote: Being able to space the floor, shoot the three, play with aggression, be unapologetically yourself, I think that's what he taught me.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on what Kevin Garnett taught him
quotes.excerpt: be ferocious, be tenacious, allow nothing to rattle you and also, don't be afraid to dominate the game
quotes.quote: Be ferocious, be tenacious, allow nothing to rattle you and also, don't be afraid to dominate the game with your energy.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on Wilt Chamberlain's scoring records
quotes.excerpt: score 100 and have no one know. Have no video of it
quotes.quote: Score 100 and have no one know. Have no video of it. Impossible statistical categories and performances are possible and it's only possible when you put your mind to it and you're willing to put the work in.

quotes.quote: The ability to take over a city as a man of color and to show people that there is more to the game that a big man could do and in a big market.
